name: workflow-nudge
description: Working-style nudges: suggests fan-out for research-type requests and parallel sub-agents for several independent tasks

parallel_agents._doc: The parallel-agents suggestion [Parallel:Suggest] fires only on strong signals: the score maxes out at 7 (conjunctions x2 + batch 2 + cross-target 1 + plural 1 + multiple files 1); ordinary requests land at 2-5, so min_score 6 or higher keeps it from firing on every prompt. max_per_session caps how many times this kind of suggestion appears in one session. The judgment (score_prompt) is unchanged; the thresholds only decide whether to print.

research_fanout._doc: Detects knowledge-retrieval prompts (look it up / search / I want to know) and injects the two-stage fan-out SOP. When it fires, the parallel_agents suggestion is suppressed to avoid duplicates. Turn off with enabled:false. Fires only on strong signals: min_signal_hits is the threshold on the total of retrieval verbs plus knowledge-domain / local-location / explicit-file hits (a request like "look up how X is used" scores 2 and does not fire; "look up and research the differences between A and B for a selection comparison, and what the official docs say" is the level that fires); max_per_session caps how many times per session. The judgment (classify) is unchanged.
